stops.title: Preparation of Aldehydes and Ketones
stops.inShort: Rosenmund reduction: R-COCl + H₂ --(Pd/BaSO₄)--> R-CHO. Stephen reaction: R-CN + SnCl₂/HCl → R-CHO. Gatterman-Koch: benzene + CO + HCl --(anhy. AlCl₃)--> benzaldehyde. Ketones from acyl chloride + dialkylcadmium (R₂Cd).

stops.title: Reactions of Aldehydes & Ketones (Aldol, Cannizzaro, Reductions)
stops.inShort: Cannizzaro reaction (aldehydes without α-H, e.g. HCHO, C₆H₅CHO + conc. NaOH → alcohol + carboxylate salt). Clemmensen reduction (Zn-Hg/conc. HCl) and Wolff-Kishner reduction (NH₂NH₂/KOH in ethylene glycol) reduce >C=O to >CH₂.
sections: 12.8 Chemical Properties of Aldehydes and Ketones

stops.title: Carboxylic Acids: Preparation, Acidity & Reactions
stops.inShort: Cyclohexene + KMnO₄/H₂SO₄ → adipic acid. Carboxylic acids are stronger acids than phenols due to equivalent resonance stabilization of carboxylate ion. Ortho-substituted/electron-withdrawing groups enhance acidity.

items.f: R-COCl + H₂ --(Pd/BaSO₄)--> R-CHO;  C₆H₆ + CO + HCl --(AlCl₃)--> C₆H₅CHO
items.s: BaSO₄ poisons Pd to prevent over-reduction.

board.text: Write the reagents used for the reduction of carbonyl group in Clemmensen's reduction.
Write the reaction for the preparation of: (i) acetaldehyde by Rosenmund reaction (ii) benzaldehyde by Gatterman-Koch formylation.
board.answer:
(i) CH₃COCl + H₂ --(Pd/BaSO₄, boiling xylene)--> CH₃CHO + HCl.
(ii) C₆H₆ + CO + HCl --(anhy. AlCl₃/CuCl)--> C₆H₅CHO + HCl.

board.text: (a) Explain Cannizzaro's reaction with the help of benzaldehyde. (b) Write the reaction for the conversion of cyclohexene to adipic acid.
board.answer:
(a) Aldehydes without α-H undergo self oxidation-reduction with 50% NaOH:
2 C₆H₅CHO + NaOH (50%) → C₆H₅CH₂OH (benzyl alcohol) + C₆H₅COONa (sodium benzoate).
(b) Cyclohexene + 4[O] --(KMnO₄ / dil. H₂SO₄, Δ)--> HOOC−(CH₂)₄−COOH (adipic acid).

board.text: Explain Wolff-Kishner reduction reaction. Write preparation of propanone by using ethanoyl chloride and dimethyl cadmium.
board.answer:
Wolff-Kishner reduction: Aldehydes or ketones heated with hydrazine (NH₂NH₂) and KOH in ethylene glycol give alkanes (>C=O → >CH₂).
Propanone preparation: 2 CH₃COCl + (CH₃)₂Cd --(dry ether)--> 2 CH₃COCH₃ (propanone) + CdCl₂.
